pages.text: Allah the Exalted says: ﴿وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'And We revealed to Musa: Travel by night with My servants; you will be followed.' Allah commanded him to travel by night with those who believed with him, because Pharaoh and his soldiers would follow them.
So Musa and those with him travelled by night. When Pharaoh heard of their journey, he sent his men to gather his army from the cities of his kingdom.

Allah brought Pharaoh and his people out of a land of gardens, springs and treasures, and they caught up with Musa and those with him at sunrise. When each side saw the other, the companions of Musa said: ﴿إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'We will surely be overtaken!'

Musa said to them: ﴿كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Never! My Lord is with me; He will guide me.' Then Allah revealed to Musa that he should strike the sea with his staff; he struck it, and it split, and each part of it was like a great mountain.
Allah brought Pharaoh and his people near until they entered the sea, and the sea stayed split until Musa and those with him had crossed to the shore. So Allah saved Musa and all those with him.

Then Allah drowned Pharaoh and those with him when the sea closed over them. In that is a wonderful lesson that shows the power of Allah, yet even with this clear sign most of Pharaoh's followers did not become believers. Among the lessons of these verses: Allah was with Musa (peace be upon him) with His help, and guided him to what saved him and those with him.
